from primitives import call

h1 = measurements["block1"]["evidence_handles"]
h2 = measurements["block2"]["evidence_handles"]
h3 = measurements["block3"]["evidence_handles"]
ht = measurements["table"]["evidence_handles"]

r1 = call(
    name="execute_robotwin2_pick_place",
    agent_context=None,
    arm_tag="left",
    evidence_handles=h1 + ht,
    lift_distance=0.12,
    pre_grasp_distance=0.08,
    pre_place_distance=0.10,
    source_actor_label="block1",
    target_actor_label="table"
)
print("block1_to_table", r1.ok, r1.output)
if r1.ok:
    r2 = call(
        name="execute_robotwin2_pick_place",
        agent_context=None,
        arm_tag="left",
        evidence_handles=h2 + h1,
        lift_distance=0.12,
        pre_grasp_distance=0.08,
        pre_place_distance=0.10,
        source_actor_label="block2",
        target_actor_label="block1"
    )
    print("block2_to_block1", r2.ok, r2.output)
else:
    r2 = None
if r2 is not None and r2.ok:
    r3 = call(
        name="execute_robotwin2_pick_place",
        agent_context=None,
        arm_tag="left",
        evidence_handles=h3 + h2,
        lift_distance=0.12,
        pre_grasp_distance=0.08,
        pre_place_distance=0.10,
        source_actor_label="block3",
        target_actor_label="block2"
    )
    print("block3_to_block2", r3.ok, r3.output)
